nodes.label: All filled conditions must match. A rule without conditions always matches.
The default layout is always used.

Rules are checked from top to bottom; the first enabled one whose conditions match chooses the layout. If none matches, the default is used. “No layout” leaves the keyboard unprocessed, for example in an application where the layout gets in the way.

Single: the layout you make active works everywhere.

Automatic: the layout is chosen by switching rules for the application, system language or game mode.

The app:activateLayout1…5 actions activate the layout at that position in this list: reordering the list changes which layout a key activates. In Auto mode they switch to Single mode.
No keyboard is selected, so the mapper cannot start.
